claim: Nvidia posted $81.6 billion of revenue in its fiscal 2027 first quarter.
summary: The claim asserts Nvidia's fiscal 2027 Q1 revenue was $81.6 billion. Nvidia's fiscal year ends in January, so fiscal 2027 Q1 is the quarter ending April 2026, reported in May 2026. As of the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, this period had not yet been reported and no pre-cutoff evidence establishes this figure. Without tools, the assertion cannot be verified.
